name: aifirst
description: Companion CLI for the AI First book series. Installs book skills into Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and VS Code, serves the book's canonical answers, and keeps a learner log.

scripts.test:learn:live: bun test test/duckling-learn-live.test.ts test/chapter10-learn-live.test.ts test/learn-confirmation-live.test.ts test/learn-interactive-regression.test.ts test/replay-learn-regression.test.ts
scripts.check: bun scripts/sync-content.ts --check && tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun test

//dependencies: Pinned to a tag rather than a sibling path so `bun install` works in CI and
on a fresh clone. For local content work, run `bun link` in an aifirstcontent
